tool: OpenSTA be771a0 (fleet sta 3.1.0), die_sta.py replica of kv3_io_cor_v1 (routed, 60 MB SPEF), 16 threads
linearity: RSS/instance 2.36-2.45 KB from N=8 to N=512 (73.4M instances, 172.8 GB): linear

decomposition_N32.note: tapcells have no timing (strip them from the STA netlist); parasitics measured on long io/ft nets (~10 R + 10 Cc per net): conservative for logic nets

full_die_extrapolation.assumption: 400 partitions x 400k logic cells, ~1 net per cell, kv-io net density, tapcells stripped, one corner per process

verdict: flat full-die signoff: NOT feasible on a 1 TB host with full parasitics (~969 GB); FEASIBLE with read_spef -reduce (~537 GB, measured 0.000 ps seam delta vs full on KV e5e6) at ~19 h per corner (serial SPEF reader dominates), TT and FF as two processes on two hosts. Continuous die checks use ilm (== flat on seams).
